items.title: Robbed, bashed, killed: How killers targeted one couple over several years
items.description: Twenty-four years after the killing of a Canberra grandmother, a coffee cup discarded on an east coast road trip leads to the arrest and convictions of her killers.

items.title: Deadly bird flu discovered in second Australian state as virus found in SA
items.description: A third confirmed case of the deadly H5 bird flu has been found in a migratory bird on Australia's southern coast.

items.title: Australia's mammals are at risk of bird flu. This is what we know
items.description: While birds are the most likely victims of the deadly strain of bird flu, researchers are also sounding the alarm for native mammals and marsupial species. These are some of the steps being taken to protect them.

items.title: Has One Nation won the 'family feud' of Australian conservatives?
items.description: There's a "family feud" in Australia's political right, and right now it appears One Nation is winning.

items.title: Police to review case of Epstein accuser Virginia Giuffre
items.description: The interactions Jeffery Epstein accuser Virginia Giuffre had with Australian police before her death will be reviewed, WA's police commissioner confirms.

items.title: Award-winning artist accused of copying second artwork
items.description: Australian artist Jane Allan, revealed to have previously copied another painter's work, is being accused of a second case of imitation.

items.title: Christian Brothers spending $1.7m a week on abuse cases
items.description: The Congregation of Christian Brothers Oceania Province has revealed it was seeking to sell off its 36 properties to pay abuse victims, who would be treated as creditors.

items.title: Karl Stefanovic's interview with Tommy Robinson taken offline
items.description: Today show host-turned-podcaster Karl Stefanovic has had his interview with far-right extremist Tommy Robinson taken down from social media and podcast platforms.

items.title: Socceroos should make 'harsh' call for final group game, Schwarzer says
items.description: As the Socceroos prepare to face Paraguay in their final FIFA World Cup group game, Aussie great Mark Schwarzer says now is the time to bring captain Mat Ryan back into the team.

items.title: Will Congress demanding US military halt action in Iran end the war?
items.description: The US Senate approved a war powers resolution seeking to block military action against Iran on Tuesday. But don't expect the war to end.

items.title: UN maritime body starts enacting plan to move sailors out of Gulf
items.description: An evacuation plan to enable hundreds of ships to sail through the Strait of Hormuz is being enacted, according to the UN's International Maritime Organization.

items.title: Bird flu has arrived in Australia
items.description: After years of waiting, the deadly H5N1 strain of bird flu has finally arrived in Australia. Two birds found on the southern coast of Western Australia near Esperance have been confirmed as infected, but there is no evidence so far of a mass-mortality event. So, what actually is H5N1, and why does it matter?

items.title: Tech billionaire accused of assaulting partner, cutting $66k Birkin bag with scissors
items.description: A billionaire tech investor accused of assaulting his former partner and stealing expensive gifts he had bought her has his bail varied so he can visit his mother in Sydney.

items.title: Wayne Bennett rubbishes 'myths' around South Sydney's injuries
items.description: Not for the first time, South Sydney is counting the cost of an outsized injury toll, with questions being asked about their training surface.

items.title: 'Really dangerous': Social media trend mummymaxxing explained
items.description: Also known as mommymaxxing and mommaxxing — depending on which internet rabbit hole you're going down — mummymaxxing focuses on optimising motherhood and experts warn it could be harmful.

items.title: Heartbroken Daryl Braithwaite will miss everything about performing
items.description: The ARIA Hall of Fame inductee speaks emotionally to the ABC about his decision to give up live performances, saying it has broken his heart to see how appreciative people have been.

items.title: Farming couple who met at bus stop celebrate 70 years of love on the land
items.description: Farming couple Bill and Val Collins share their secrets to a long marriage as they celebrate their platinum wedding anniversary.

items.title: Murray-Darling Basin communities call for balance in review
items.description: Communities across the Murray-Darling Basin are calling for a better balance, as irrigators say water buybacks are hurting their communities.

items.title: Man, 76, dies in plane crash near Northam, north-east of Perth
items.description: Police say a light plane crashed in Malabaine on Wednesday morning, with the pilot and sole occupant of the aircraft found dead at the scene.

items.title: ICAC told favoured candidates got questions before uni's job interviews
items.description: A University of Wollongong governance manager has admitted that recruitment processes that led to her appointment were not fair or transparent.

items.title: Qld water minister calls on major water retailer to abandon price hikes
items.description: South-east Queensland households will face a higher price hike on their water and sewerage bills next year.

items.title: New registry established as MND becomes 'notifiable disease' in NSW
items.description: An MND expert says the registry is a first step to help identify what causes the incurable disease and how it could be stopped.

items.title: Matt Wright sued for negligence after airboat allegedly crashed into tree
items.description: A man who says he suffered a "psychiatric injury" after witnessing injuries sustained by his wife in a 2023 airboat crash is suing tour operator and Netflix star Matt Wright for negligence.

items.title: Court hears girl was groomed to repopulate 'post-apocalyptic' world
items.description: A complainant has told a court that alleged NSW South Coast cult leader William "Little Pebble" Kamm groomed her for more than a decade.

items.title: Family shares significant update on Sydney shark attack victim's condition
items.description: A Sydney mother mauled by a shark at Coogee Beach almost a fortnight ago has spoken her first words after briefly waking from an induced coma.
